name: Workers
overview: Scripture highlights the dignity and purpose of diligent work, emphasizing that the labor of our hands is to be established and blessed by the Lord (Psalms 90:17). The Proverbs affirm that diligence leads to leadership and profit, while mere talk results in poverty (Proverbs 12:24; 14:23). Believers are encouraged to commit their efforts to the Lord for stability and to labor not only for personal gain but also to support others in need, reflecting Christ’s teaching that it is more blessed to give than to receive (Proverbs 16:3; Acts 20:35; Ephesians 4:28).
